courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 既有隧道漏水修繕
related.transfer: 可遷移「地下水與施工用水收支」與「堵塞敏感度與維護」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；既有隧道漏水修繕的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Groundwater and process-water balance" and "Blockage sensitivity and maintenance" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Leakage repair in existing tunnels must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水；既有隧道漏水修繕則以以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy; Leakage repair in existing tunnels centres on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地下水與施工用水收支」與「凝結與地下水來源」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到既有隧道漏水修繕，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「排水保留與壓力轉移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Groundwater and process-water balance” and “Condensation and groundwater sources”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Leakage repair in existing tunnels, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drainage preservation and pressure transfer", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道湧水排導系統
history.text: 本課討論的用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.textEn: The course turns "Groundwater and process-water balance" through "Long-term hydrology and handover" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
